title: Bribed input
statement: For a coordinate set $J\subseteq[n]$, a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the modified input by setting every coordinate in $J$ equal to $b$ and leaving every coordinate outside $J$ equal to its value in $x$.
